status_definitions.VALIDATED: passed predefined controlled, held-out AND causal checks (deterministic guarantee or held-out+causal on the synthetic corpus)
status_definitions.CONTROLLED-EVIDENCE: validated only in synthetic or simulated conditions; live-model / real-corpus external validity pending
status_definitions.IMPLEMENTED: code exists and tests pass, external performance not validated
status_definitions.RETIRED: earlier hypothesis no longer part of the authorized architecture

claims.claim: Every output evidence ID resolves to the authoritative ledger and provenance is preserved.
claims.scope: synthetic procurement corpus; deterministic guarantee enforced by tests
claims.allowed_vc_wording: Evidence-ID preservation was 1.00 in every tested arm of the controlled study.
claims.forbidden_overstatement: Do not claim this has been proven on live enterprise data.

claims.claim: Unauthorized evidence is never admitted to slots, reasoning, or output.
claims.scope: deterministic access-control gate; synthetic corpus + tests
claims.allowed_vc_wording: Unauthorized-evidence inclusion was 0.00 in the controlled study.
claims.forbidden_overstatement: Do not claim certified enterprise security compliance.

claims.claim: A deterministic P5 binding-slot policy preserves required evidence across streaming/multi-step workflows.
claims.scope: synthetic streaming/multi-step workflow; held-out entities/templates; dev 0.60 ~= held-out 0.60
claims.allowed_vc_wording: In the controlled streaming study, a deterministic slot policy raised required-evidence survival from ~0.30 to 1.00 and outcome accuracy from ~0.40 to ~0.75, and removing required evidence degraded accuracy far more than removing irrelevant evidence.
claims.forbidden_overstatement: Do not claim slots beat retrieval universally or on one-shot workloads.

claims.claim: Active-version selection accuracy is credited to the deterministic policy, not to Quadratic version reasoning.
claims.scope: synthetic; only ~11% of cases retained both active and stale versions
claims.allowed_vc_wording: Version accuracy improved to ~0.80, but because active+stale co-survival was only ~0.11, the improvement is credited to deterministic active-version retention, not to Quadratic active-vs-stale comparison.
claims.forbidden_overstatement: Do not claim Quadratic proved active-versus-stale version reasoning.

claims.claim: Bounded full slot-to-slot Quadratic comparison improves contradiction detection and beats query-to-slot-only.
claims.metric: conflict F1; S5 vs S6 accuracy
claims.value: conflict F1 0.91-0.99; S5 full self-attn 0.69 > S6 query-to-slot 0.60
claims.allowed_vc_wording: Full slot-to-slot comparison reached conflict F1 of 0.91-0.99 and outperformed query-to-slot-only attention in the controlled study.
claims.forbidden_overstatement: Do not generalize the synergy beyond the tested streaming/multi-step workflow.

claims.claim: The smallest sufficient evidence capacity is contract-dependent; larger context can hurt.
claims.value: role task: K4 0.90 > K8 0.69 > K16 0.56 > K32 0.39; outcome contract: K8 required (0.803) > K4 (0.543)
claims.allowed_vc_wording: The smallest sufficient capacity was contract-dependent (K=4 best for the small role task, K=8 needed for the full outcome contract), and over-large context degraded accuracy by admitting noise.
claims.forbidden_overstatement: Do not claim K=4 is universally optimal.

claims.claim: A deterministic/constrained outcome mapper produces the correct outcome given correct typed fields, with zero mapping error.
claims.metric: O5 oracle outcome accuracy; O1 output_mapping_error_rate
claims.value: O5 = 1.00; O1 mapping error 0.00 (vs O0 learned 0.195)
claims.allowed_vc_wording: Given correct typed fields, the deterministic mapper produced 1.00 outcome accuracy with 0.00 mapping error; the learned latent head had 0.195 mapping error.
claims.forbidden_overstatement: Do not claim the mapper alone lifted end-to-end accuracy; field prediction was upstream.

claims.claim: For the tested contract, the relevant enterprise fields were deterministic functions of exact retained evidence and were better computed than predicted.
claims.metric: held-out outcome accuracy; field macro; conflict F1
claims.value: F0 learned: outcome 0.64, field macro 0.84, conflict F1 0.26; F1 deterministic: outcome 1.00, field macro 0.955, conflict F1 1.00
claims.scope: synthetic held-out entities/templates; dev = held-out; one procurement contract
claims.allowed_vc_wording: For the tested structured procurement contract, computing typed fields deterministically gave perfect held-out outcomes (1.00) versus 0.64 for a learned field head, with a small residual intermediate field-label discrepancy (macro 0.955) that did not affect the mapped result.
claims.forbidden_overstatement: Do not claim every intermediate field was perfectly predicted, and do not generalize beyond this contract.

claims.claim: The normalization validator admits zero unsupported facts to the authoritative ledger regardless of interpreter quality.
claims.metric: unsupported_fact_admission_rate; exact-field extraction; source-span match; governed downstream accuracy
claims.value: unsupported admission 0.000 at q=0.70..1.00; exact fields 1.00; span 1.00; governed downstream 0.92 (q=0.85) -> 0.947 (q=1.0); N5 oracle 1.00; ungoverned N1 0.35 with 0.177 admission
claims.scope: synthetic corpus; interpreter is a CONTROLLABLE SIMULATOR, not a live model
claims.allowed_vc_wording: Under controlled failure injection, the normalization gate admitted 0.00 unsupported facts at every simulated interpreter-quality level, while an ungoverned baseline admitted ~17.7%; governed downstream accuracy was 0.92-0.95 versus 1.00 for oracle-normalized evidence.
claims.forbidden_overstatement: Do not imply GPT/Claude/Gemini/open-weight models achieved these normalization results; live-model interpretation is unvalidated.

claims.claim: TAP independently blocks unsupported, contradicted, and authority-exceeding claims where prompt-only grounding does not.
claims.metric: unsupported-claim recall; authority-exceedance recall; supported-claim precision; qualifier preservation
claims.value: prompt-only (T1): unsupported recall 0.00, authority recall 0.00; TAP+ceilings (T3): unsupported recall 1.00, authority recall 1.00, supported precision 1.00, qualifier preservation 1.00
claims.scope: synthetic; drafts generated with controlled overclaim injection (the failure modes are simulated)
claims.allowed_vc_wording: Under controlled overclaim injection, prompt-only grounding caught 0% of unsupported and authority-exceeding claims while TAP with deterministic ceilings caught 100% of both without over-blocking supported claims.
claims.forbidden_overstatement: Do not claim live-model TAP generalization until real unrestricted model outputs are evaluated.

claims.claim: Prompting asks a model to remain grounded; TAP independently checks whether it did.
claims.allowed_vc_wording: In the controlled study, system-prompt grounding did not enforce; independent TAP checking did.
claims.forbidden_overstatement: Do not present as a live-model benchmark result.

claims.claim: Governance reacts to material corruptions and is invariant to irrelevant ones.
claims.value: span removal blocked 1.00; provenance corruption blocked 1.00; irrelevant-document injection outcome-invariant; required-eviction >> irrelevant-eviction degradation
claims.allowed_vc_wording: Causal controls behaved as required: removing supporting evidence or corrupting provenance blocked the assertion, while injecting irrelevant documents did not change the exact findings.
claims.forbidden_overstatement: Do not claim adversarial robustness; only the specified controls were run.

claims.claim: The external-model handoff packet is bounded, tenant-safe, and returns structured interpretations only.
claims.metric: tokens local vs external; sensitive-field exposure; prohibited-conclusions declared
claims.value: packet contains only unresolved spans + tenant-safe ids; prohibited conclusions declared; external returns structured interpretations
claims.scope: implemented + tested; no live external-model call executed
claims.allowed_vc_wording: The bounded handoff is implemented and tested to send only minimal spans and tenant-safe identifiers with prohibited conclusions declared.
claims.forbidden_overstatement: Do not claim measured token/cost savings against a live frontier model.

claims.claim: A ~240K-param pure-phase model reached 100% needle-in-haystack retrieval at 2K/10K on a controlled task.
claims.value: 100% at 2K and 10K on a controlled synthetic retrieval task
claims.scope: mechanism-level, tiny model, synthetic; NOT a product or enterprise result
claims.allowed_vc_wording: A tiny pure-phase model showed 100% controlled needle retrieval at 10K tokens - historical mechanism-level evidence only.
claims.forbidden_overstatement: Do not present as a product long-context advantage or as validated at scale.

claims.claim: Frozen Phase adds causal long-range information-health value in the enterprise late-fusion setting.
claims.metric: A3(phase) vs A1(no phase) macro; causal dependence; vs GRU baseline
claims.value: A3 0.751 ~= A1 0.752 (delta -0.0015); persistence gain -0.010; causal dependence FAILED (zero/shuffle/reverse/removal produced no dependence); trained GRU baseline 0.834 > Phase
claims.scope: synthetic enterprise persistence/recurrence late-fusion at N=1024
claims.allowed_vc_wording: In the enterprise auxiliary experiment, frozen Phase added no measurable causal information-health signal and was outperformed by a trained GRU baseline; it has no authorized production role.
claims.forbidden_overstatement: Do not present Phase as a validated enterprise capability.

claims.claim: Protected Phase / serial fusion removes the long-context decay tax and is a validated global-retrieval substrate ready for commercialization.
claims.value: no committed external benchmark supports this; enterprise Phase value UNSUPPORTED
claims.scope: removed from the authorized production architecture
claims.allowed_vc_wording: Phase is an experimental research track with no authorized production role; product claims of decay-tax removal or global-retrieval superiority are retired pending a new mechanistic hypothesis and independent external evidence.
claims.forbidden_overstatement: Do not state phase removes decay, is a validated retrieval substrate, or is production-ready.

claims.claim: Serial fusion is proven to beat parallel stacking by reducing gradient competition.
claims.value: no committed ablation isolates gradient competition or serial-vs-parallel superiority
claims.allowed_vc_wording: Serial fusion is a design hypothesis; no committed benchmark demonstrates a gradient-competition advantage.
claims.forbidden_overstatement: Do not claim gradient competition has been proven.

claims.claim: Live frontier/local models achieve the normalization and TAP results shown here on real documents.
claims.scope: the interpreter was a controllable simulator; live-model + human-adjudicated corpus is future work
claims.allowed_vc_wording: Live-model document interpretation and TAP generalization are the top external-validity roadmap items.
claims.forbidden_overstatement: Do not present any live-model result as achieved.
